review_notes: I read the whole file and searched for repeated nontrivial blocks. Three repeats are reported: the integral-to-lintegral step in lintegral_section and section_β, the entrywise continuity proofs for sigmaGL and toTensorGL, and the Units-embedding topology instances for G and GF. I confirmed that Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map is defined as Units.map and that Continuous.units_map exists in Mathlib. I did not find a Mathlib lemma that gives the integral-to-lintegral step directly. I could not compile anything, so the proposed rewrites are untested. In particular, whether the sigmaGL and toTensorGL rewrites unify depends on the defeq between GeneralLinearGroup.map and Units.map, and on coercion forms such as `⇑(sigmaTensor ...)`. I did not report the near-duplicate pairs c1_mul_of_mem / c2_mul_of_mem and isUnit_c1 / isUnit_c2. They are short simp calls, so they do not meet the rubric's bar.

theorem continuous_sigmaGL : Continuous (AutomorphicForm.sigmaGL K L F σ : G → G) := by
  refine continuous_GL_of (fun i j => ?_) (fun i j => ?_)
findings.problem: Both proofs show that a `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map f` is continuous (sigmaGL with f = sigmaTensor; toTensorGL with f = includeRight), and they do it with the same entrywise argument. First they go through continuous_GL_of to a value goal and an inverse goal. Then the value goal is solved with `simp only [coe_…GL, Matrix.map_apply]` plus `.comp (Units.continuous_val.matrix_elem i j)`. The inverse goal is solved by proving a `have this : ∀ x, ((f x)⁻¹) i j = … ((x⁻¹) i j)` via `← map_inv`, then `simp_rw [this]`, then `.comp (Units.continuous_coe_inv.matrix_elem i j)`. The ~10-line block is duplicated at lines 1019–1027 with only the entry map changed. Mathlib already has `Continuous.units_map`, and `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map f` is by definition `Units.map (RingHom.mapMatrix f).toMonoidHom`.
findings.proposed_change:
Prove once a lemma such as
`theorem continuous_GL_map {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [TopologicalSpace R] [TopologicalSpace S] {f : R →+* S} (hf : Continuous f) : Continuous (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (n := Fin 2) f)`.
Proof sketch: `Continuous.units_map _ (continuous_pi fun i => continuous_pi fun j => hf.comp ((continuous_apply j).comp (continuous_apply i)))`, adjusting for the coercion of `(RingHom.mapMatrix f).toMonoidHom`. Then `continuous_sigmaGL := continuous_GL_map (continuous_sigmaTensor σ)` and `continuous_toTensorGL := continuous_GL_map continuous_emb`, using `emb = includeRight`. The unfolding of `sigmaGL` and `toTensorGL`, and the continuity of `includeRight` (which equals `algebraMap F E` or `emb` up to `rfl`), are the points the lemma statement must match.
findings.benefit: One short continuity argument replaces two ~10-line entrywise proofs. The coe_sigmaGL/coe_toTensorGL-based rewriting is no longer needed for continuity. The structure then follows Mathlib's `Continuous.units_map`.

findings.problem: secondCountableTopology_GL (for GL₂(E)) and secondCountableTopology_GF (lines 895–900, for GL₂(F)) are the same proof. Both get SecondCountableTopology of the matrix ring by `inferInstanceAs` through the Pi type. Both transfer it to the opposite ring via `MulOpposite.opHomeomorph.symm.isEmbedding`. Both finish with `Units.isEmbedding_embedProduct`. Only the base ring changes. The T2 instances t2Space_GF and t2Space_GL repeat the Units-embedding argument in the same way.
findings.proposed_change: State one lemma over a topological ring R, e.g. `theorem secondCountableTopology_GL2 (R : Type*) [Ring R] [TopologicalSpace R] [SecondCountableTopology R] : SecondCountableTopology (GL (Fin 2) R)`, with the three-step proof as its body. Then define `secondCountableTopology_GL := secondCountableTopology_GL2 E` and `secondCountableTopology_GF := secondCountableTopology_GL2 F`. The `E` instance secondCountableTopology_E is already registered as a local instance before line 279. `F` is the adic completion, which is second countable by existing instances, as the current GF proof already uses.
findings.benefit: Removes a duplicated 6-line topological argument. A reader sees that GL₂ inherits second countability from the base ring, and any fix to the embedding argument is made once.
